name: windows-server-mcp
description: Agentless Windows Server health checks over WinRM: one verdict per server, a diffable inventory, and no arbitrary PowerShell.

windows_server_password.title: WINDOWS_SERVER_PASSWORD
windows_server_password.description: Password for the WinRM account shared by servers that have no password stored with servers login

windows_server_username.title: WINDOWS_SERVER_USERNAME
windows_server_username.description: WinRM account name (a local or domain account in the server's Administrators group)

windows_server_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
windows_server_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to offer only tools that change nothing: services restart, services start, health and inventory snapshot are removed. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

windows_server_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
windows_server_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local store: health prints verdicts without recording history or events, and inventory snapshot is refused. Leave blank to keep the local store.

windows_server_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
windows_server_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

windows_server_base_url.title: Internal virtual base URL (leave blank)
windows_server_base_url.description: Leave blank. The CLI's internal request surface is the fixed https://winrm.invalid; any other value is refused. Servers come only from the config file's [[servers]] entries.

windows_server_user_agent.title: User-Agent header (optional)
windows_server_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on WinRM requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
